resources.string: Bring in the SET_UP folder from the disc of your own copy of the game (the folder with SCRIPT.LPK, PIC.LPK and the other files).
Sending lines to a mining server is off (optional: bring in the mining.txt of your mining server below)

Saves without a sound every %1$d lines and when you leave the app, into a slot of its own that the game\'s menus do not show. The game then starts at that line, past the title menu. Your saves and quick saves stay as they are.
Option 1: connect this device to a computer with a cable, allow file transfer, and copy the SET_UP folder into %1$s on the device.

Option 2: have the folder on this device first (in Downloads, on a memory card, on a USB stick), then import it with the button below. The app makes its own copy, so the original can be deleted afterwards.
Copying %1$s: %2$s of %3$s. Keep the app open.
A folder named %1$s is already in the app. Replace it with the one you chose?
The folder was copied, but there is no SCRIPT.LPK in it. Choose the game\'s SET_UP folder.
The chosen file could not be read.
The chosen file is not a mining.txt. Download it from your mining server\'s settings.
Remove mining.txt? The game then sends no lines until you bring one in again.
Controls: tap = left button · tap with two fingers or back = right button (menu) · swipe up or down = wheel (history) · long press = skip.
A mouse, a keyboard or a game controller works too, as on the PC.
A dictionary over the game\'s text, and cards for Anki.
Off: a tap on the text reads on.
On, but without a dictionary no word is found.
On: %1$s, cards go to the deck %2$s.
On: %1$s, words are looked up. No cards yet: %2$s
The dictionary cannot be shown on this device: %1$s
Look words up in the game

A tap on a word of the text then shows the dictionary, and the game waits until the dictionary is closed. The text box no longer reads on: tap the picture above it, or use a key, the wheel or a controller.
Key, if it asks for one
Key (one is kept; type to replace it)
Connected. The Lapis note type is there.
Connected. There is no Lapis note type: choose a note type and what goes into its fields.
The Lapis note type\'s fields are filled as its makers mean them to be. In any other note type, choose what each field gets.

Cards go to the AnkiConnect you name here: the one of Anki on your computer, or a server of your own. With the Lapis note type there is nothing more to choose. An address in your own network may start with http; any other has to start with https. The key is kept on this device only, sealed with a key of the device\'s own.
This device could not keep it: it has to be entered again after the app was closed.
The address of a dictionary in Yomitan\'s format (a zip file).
Dictionaries in Yomitan\'s format (zip files) are kept on this device. A word\'s meanings are shown in this order. Dictionaries of frequencies and of pitch accents count too.
An address is kept; type to replace it

plurals.item: It answers, with %1$d sound for 食べる.
It answers, with %1$d sounds for 食べる.

resources.string: The address of an audio source as Yomitan takes a custom one, with {term} and {reading} where the word and its reading go. The popup plays its sounds, and a card gets the one chosen. The address is kept like the key, as it often holds a key.
